title: Battle of Umm Diwaykarat
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Umm Diwaykarat", at revision 1370591977, opens: "The Battle of Umm Diwaykarat on 25 November 1899 marked the final defeat of the Mahdist State in Sudan, when Anglo-Egyptian forces under the command of Lord Kitchener defeated what was left of the Mahdist armies under the command of the Abdallahi ibn Muhammad, known as the Khalifa, after the equally disastrous Battle of Omdurman a year earlier." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q476402, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1899 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
